既往经治非鳞NSCLC中Dato-DXd单药较多西他赛PFS HR 0.63（95%CI 0.51–0.79；229/232），提示抗肿瘤活性，但属后线、单药、不同对照且未分离目标TROP2阳性人群。

evidence.source_anchor: TROPION-Lung04 first-line efficacy subgroup paragraphs/table; confirmed or pending confirmation

evidence.title: INAVO121 frozen registered design

evidence.text: Roche reports INAVO120 met its primary PFS endpoint in Q4 2023. It compared inavolisib + palbociclib + fulvestrant with placebo + palbociclib + fulvestrant in PIK3CA-mutant HR-positive advanced breast cancer. INAVO121 instead compares two active PI3K inhibitors after CDK4/6 therapy, without palbociclib. The prior trial is indirect and cannot establish head-to-head superiority.

evidence.text: Frozen registry NCT06551324: MEVPRO-1; enrollment 600 (ESTIMATED); allocation RANDOMIZED; masking NONE. Selected primary endpoint: Radiographic Progression Free Survival (rPFS) assessed by blinded independent central review (BICR) per RECIST v1.1 and Prostate Cancer Clinical Trials Working Group 3 (PCWG3). Definition: rPFS is defined as the time from the date of randomization to first objective evidence of radiographic progression as assessed in soft tissue per Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) v1.1 or in bone per Prostate Cancer Clinical Trials Working Group 3 (PCWG3) guidelines by BICR, or death, whichever occurs first.. Timeframe: Randomization up to approximately 2 years.. There are 1 registered primary-outcome entries. Protocol publication clarifies final rPFS analysis; operative SAP amendments and event maturity are not independently verified.
evidence.title: MEVPRO-1 frozen registered design

evidence.text: The sponsor-authored protocol publication reports an 81-patient dose-expansion comparison with median rPFS 14.3 months for mevrometostat + enzalutamide versus 6.2 months for enzalutamide. This is not MEVPRO-1 and does not cover its docetaxel comparator. The phase III protocol describes a stratified two-sided log-rank rPFS analysis with no rPFS interim analysis, and hierarchical rPFS then OS testing. Exact current operative SAP, event maturity and adherence remain unknown.
evidence.title: Published protocol and phase I background

target.comparison: Mevrometostat 875 mg twice daily with food + enzalutamide 160 mg/day versus physician choice enzalutamide or docetaxel.
target.endpoint: Radiographic Progression Free Survival (rPFS) assessed by blinded independent central review (BICR) per RECIST v1.1 and Prostate Cancer Clinical Trials Working Group 3 (PCWG3)
target.population: Metastatic castration-resistant prostate adenocarcinoma progressing after abiraterone in mCSPC or first-line mCRPC; ECOG 0-2; randomized analysis population.

evidence.title: Negative same-asset first-line prior

Both are advanced-disease contexts and differ from CAMBRIA-1 adjuvant switch monotherapy and invasive breast cancer-free survival.

evidence.title: AVANZAR frozen registered design

evidence.text: TROPION-Lung01 compared Dato-DXd monotherapy with docetaxel after prior NSCLC therapy. The non-squamous subgroup had PFS HR 0.63 (95% CI 0.51-0.79), n=229 versus 232. This subgroup does not isolate AVANZAR TROP2-positive patients. Line, combination and comparator differ; this is not an AVANZAR effect estimate.
evidence.title: Indirect later-line randomized Dato evidence

evidence.source_anchor: TROPION-Lung04 first-line efficacy subgroup paragraphs/table; confirmed or pending confirmation
evidence.text: In the small phase Ib TROPION-Lung04 first-line subgroup, Dato-DXd + durvalumab + carboplatin had confirmed-or-pending-confirmation responses in 10/13 patients (76.9%, 95% CI 46.2-95.0). Dato-DXd + durvalumab had 7/14 responses (50%). These are nonrandomized cohorts, response rather than PFS, with no randomized standard-care comparator or isolation of AVANZAR TROP2-positive population. The triplet safety population included 14 patients and must not be given the 13-patient first-line efficacy denominator. This does not establish an AVANZAR effect.
evidence.title: Indirect first-line combination response evidence

evidence.text: WO2020240467A1 Example 7, PDF page 93, Table 2 (data cutoff 2019-11-16): phase 1 open-label DS-1062a in previously treated NSCLC. Investigator-assessed UNCONFIRMED objective responses: 6 mg/kg 5/18 = 27.8% (exact 95% CI 9.7–53.5%); 8 mg/kg 13/34 = 38.2% (22.2–56.4%). 88/95 were response evaluable across ALL dose groups; 88 is not a denominator for either selected dose. No randomized concurrent comparator. This is ORR, not PFS, and cannot be substituted for AVANZAR benefit or compared causally with docetaxel. Patent PDF p87 [0419] identifies ADC(1)=DS-1062a; p88 cites NCT03401385. Official NCI and current registry identify DS-1062a/DS1062a as datopotamab deruxtecan; those identity sources were obtained 2026-10-22. Two AI roles checked pages/identity/numbers, share a base model, and have correlated error risk. Human scientific reviews=0; no clinical validation; full regulatory sequence alignment not performed. Only this selected experiment, not other examples or ADC(2), is included.
evidence.title: 一期 DS-1062a 研究中的未确认客观缓解率

evidence.text: Frozen registry NCT05687266: AVANZAR; enrollment 1350 (ACTUAL); allocation RANDOMIZED; masking NONE. Selected primary endpoint: Progression-Free Survival (PFS) by blinded independent central review (BICR) in the non-squamous TROP2 biomarker positive population. Definition: PFS is deﬁned as time from randomisation until progression per Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors, Version 1.1 (RECIST 1.1) as assessed by BICR, or death due to any cause.. Timeframe: Approximately 3 years. There are 4 registered primary-outcome entries. Four primary hypotheses and biomarker enrichment; multiplicity allocation, event count and target effect unknown. Registry primary completion is not a readout date.
evidence.title: AVANZAR frozen registered design

evidence.source_anchor: XML table-wrap id=tbl2, Overall Efficacy for All Patients and by Histology, nonsquamous columns; table footnotes
evidence.text: TROPION-Lung01 was a randomized comparison of Dato-DXd monotherapy versus docetaxel after prior NSCLC therapy. Table 2 reports 234 patients per arm in the nonsquamous histology efficacy subgroup, not 229 versus 232. Median PFS was 5.5 versus 3.6 months, HR 0.63 (95% CI 0.51-0.79). In the overall population, OS was not significantly improved: HR 0.94 (95% CI 0.78-1.14), p=0.530. Histology subgroups used electronic case-report-form data. These patients do not isolate AVANZAR TROP2-positive disease. Treatment line, combination, comparator and hypothesis differ; neither the PFS signal nor the overall OS null result establishes AVANZAR efficacy.
evidence.title: Corrected indirect randomized Dato evidence

evidence.source_anchor: TROPION-Lung04 first-line efficacy subgroup paragraphs/table; confirmed or pending confirmation
evidence.text: In the small phase Ib TROPION-Lung04 first-line subgroup, Dato-DXd + durvalumab + carboplatin had confirmed-or-pending-confirmation responses in 10/13 patients (76.9%, 95% CI 46.2-95.0). Dato-DXd + durvalumab had 7/14 responses (50%). These are nonrandomized cohorts, response rather than PFS, with no randomized standard-care comparator or isolation of AVANZAR TROP2-positive population. The triplet safety population included 14 patients and must not be given the 13-patient first-line efficacy denominator. This does not establish an AVANZAR effect.
evidence.title: Indirect first-line combination response evidence

evidence.text:
Frozen registry NCT04895241: TOPAZ-1; enrollment 548 (ACTUAL); allocation RANDOMIZED; masking QUADRUPLE. Selected primary endpoint: Percentage of Participants Who Achieved a Systemic Lupus Erythematosus Responder Index of 4 (SRI-4) Response at Week 52. Definition: SRI-4 response is a composite endpoint defined by the following criteria:

* Reduction from baseline of ≥4 points in systemic lupus erythematosus disease activity index 2000 (SLEDAI-2K).
* No new organ system affected, as defined by no new organ system with British isles lupus assessment group-2004 (BILAG-2004) grade A and no more than 1 new organ system with BILAG-2004 grade B compared with Baseline.
* No worsening from baseline in lupus disease activity as defined by \<0.3-point increase on 3-point Physician's Global Assessment (PGA) - Visual Analog Scale (VAS).
* No violation to protocol-specified medication rules.. Timeframe: Week 52. There are 1 registered primary-outcome entries. High-dose group only. Milligram dose not disclosed in retrieved registry; do not guess. Low-dose success or other TOPAZ-named trial does not resolve target.
evidence.title: TOPAZ-1 frozen registered design

evidence.text: Biogen reports LILAC Part A met its primary active-joint-count endpoint in SLE versus placebo. TOPAZ-1 uses the different SRI-4 composite at Week 52 and multiple dose arms. Separate LILAC CLE results and AMETHYST skin outcomes do not establish TOPAZ-1 efficacy; no numerical target effect or dose response is supplied.
evidence.title: LILAC phase II SLE prior

* Distant recurrence
* Invasive contralateral breast cancer
* Death attributable to any cause.. Timeframe: Up to 10 years. There are 1 registered primary-outcome entries. Sponsor year-only 2027 timing; no invented exact date. Post-treatment early recurrence and metastatic PFS are different outcomes.

evidence.text: SERENA-4 camizestrant + palbociclib versus anastrozole + palbociclib did not meet primary PFS superiority in upfront first-line advanced ER-positive disease. Both are advanced-disease contexts and differ from CAMBRIA-1 adjuvant switch monotherapy and invasive breast cancer-free survival.

evidence.text: Sanofi reports MOBILIZE in standard-care-refractory CIDP was stopped after interim futility assessment in June 2026; no new safety signal was identified. evidence.title: Negative riliprubart prior in a different CIDP population

evidence.source_anchor: Results from part A and B; About the phase 2 study
evidence.text: Sanofi reported an open-label, multicentre phase 2 CIDP study without a randomized comparator. At week 24, 42/48 SOC-treated patients (87%), 16/18 SOC-refractory patients (89%) and 11/12 SOC-naive patients (92%) improved or remained stable. Improvement alone occurred in 25/48 treated patients (52%) and 9/18 refractory patients (50%). These combined stable-or-improved proportions are not one shared primary response endpoint: Part A primary was relapse after SOC withdrawal for treated patients, and response during treatment for refractory/naive patients. Part B was an optional 52-week extension whose primary endpoint was long-term safety/tolerability. Two deaths occurred in patients with significant comorbidities; the release does not establish drug causality. SOC included immunoglobulins or corticosteroids. Nonrandomization, cohort differences, endpoint differences and selected extension participation prevent an estimate of superiority over maintenance IVIg in VITALIZE.
evidence.title: Indirect open-label riliprubart CIDP week-24 evidence

evidence.source_anchor: Printed PDF page 17: Neurology: riliprubart potential to expand in neuroinflammation; condition immediately above cohort charts
evidence.text: Sanofi's December 2025 presentation reports phase 2 CIDP extension outcomes at week 76 only among patient groups who achieved the week-24 primary endpoint. The conditional cohorts were SOC-treated n=40, SOC-refractory n=9 and SOC-naive n=7: 80% were relapse-free, 78% had sustained response and 86% had sustained response, respectively. Non-evaluable proportions were 13%, 11% and 14%; reported relapse proportions were 7% and 11% in the first two groups. These are open-label conditional extension outcomes, not percentages of the original 48/18/12 cohorts and not randomized treatment effects. They support potential durability in selected responders but cannot estimate VITALIZE week-24 adjusted-INCAT superiority against maintenance IVIg. Part B's primary endpoint was long-term safety/tolerability, as defined in the 2024 study description.
evidence.title: Conditional open-label riliprubart CIDP week-76 evidence

evidence.text: TROPION-Lung01 was a randomized comparison of Dato-DXd monotherapy versus docetaxel after prior NSCLC therapy. Table 2 reports 234 patients per arm in the nonsquamous histology efficacy subgroup, not 229 versus 232. Median PFS was 5.5 versus 3.6 months, HR 0.63 (95% CI 0.51-0.79). In the overall population, OS was not significantly improved: HR 0.94 (95% CI 0.78-1.14), p=0.530. Histology subgroups used electronic case-report-form data. These patients do not isolate AVANZAR TROP2-positive disease. Treatment line, combination, comparator and hypothesis differ; neither the PFS signal nor the overall OS null result establishes AVANZAR efficacy.
evidence.title: Corrected indirect randomized Dato evidence

evidence.source_anchor: TROPION-Lung04 first-line efficacy subgroup paragraphs/table; confirmed or pending confirmation
evidence.text: In the small phase Ib TROPION-Lung04 first-line subgroup, Dato-DXd + durvalumab + carboplatin had confirmed-or-pending-confirmation responses in 10/13 patients (76.9%, 95% CI 46.2-95.0). Dato-DXd + durvalumab had 7/14 responses (50%). These are nonrandomized cohorts, response rather than PFS, with no randomized standard-care comparator or isolation of AVANZAR TROP2-positive population. The triplet safety population included 14 patients and must not be given the 13-patient first-line efficacy denominator. This does not establish an AVANZAR effect.
evidence.title: Indirect first-line combination response evidence

evidence.text: WO2020240467A1 Example 7, PDF page 93, Table 2 (data cutoff 2019-11-16): phase 1 open-label DS-1062a in previously treated NSCLC. Investigator-assessed UNCONFIRMED objective responses: 6 mg/kg 5/18 = 27.8% (exact 95% CI 9.7–53.5%); 8 mg/kg 13/34 = 38.2% (22.2–56.4%). 88/95 were response evaluable across ALL dose groups; 88 is not a denominator for either selected dose. No randomized concurrent comparator. This is ORR, not PFS, and cannot be substituted for AVANZAR benefit or compared causally with docetaxel. Patent PDF p87 [0419] identifies ADC(1)=DS-1062a; p88 cites NCT03401385. Official NCI and current registry identify DS-1062a/DS1062a as datopotamab deruxtecan; those identity sources were obtained 2026-10-22. Two AI roles checked pages/identity/numbers, share a base model, and have correlated error risk. Human scientific reviews=0; no clinical validation; full regulatory sequence alignment not performed. Only this selected experiment, not other examples or ADC(2), is included.
evidence.title: 一期 DS-1062a 研究中的未确认客观缓解率

No randomized concurrent comparator. This is ORR, not PFS, and cannot be substituted for AVANZAR benefit or compared causally with docetaxel. Patent PDF p87 [0419] identifies ADC(1)=DS-1062a; p88 cites NCT03401385. Official NCI and current registry identify DS-1062a/DS1062a as datopotamab deruxtecan; those identity sources were obtained 2026-10-22. Two AI roles checked pages/identity/numbers, share a base model, and have correlated error risk. Human scientific reviews=0; no clinical validation; full regulatory sequence alignment not performed. Only this selected experiment, not other examples or ADC(2), is included.

TROPION-Lung01为经治Dato-DXd单药对多西他赛，非鳞亚组PFS HR0.63且总体OS阴性；不分离TROP2阳性，线数/联合/对照/假设均不同，不能确立AVANZAR。
一线三联仅Ib期13例疗效denominator的ORR 10/13，非随机、无PFS和标准对照、未限定TROP2阳性；安全人口14例不可混用，不证明AVANZAR疗效。

payload.target_definition: The first official decisive prespecified primary analysis of BICR PFS in non-squamous TROP2-positive patients reports statistically qualifying superiority favoring the experimental regimen over the specified comparator in the specified analysis population, under the operative protocol/SAP including any interim and multiplicity rules. Other populations/endpoints, nominal significance, non-target trial results, approval, silence, delay and commercial discontinuation without decisive endpoint assessment do not resolve the target. If SAP qualification or the exact analysis population remains unclear, outcome remains unresolved.

evidence.text: Frozen registry NCT06551324: MEVPRO-1; enrollment 600 (ESTIMATED); allocation RANDOMIZED; masking NONE. Selected primary endpoint: Radiographic Progression Free Survival (rPFS) assessed by blinded independent central review (BICR) per RECIST v1.1 and Prostate Cancer Clinical Trials Working Group 3 (PCWG3). Definition: rPFS is defined as the time from the date of randomization to first objective evidence of radiographic progression as assessed in soft tissue per Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) v1.1 or in bone per Prostate Cancer Clinical Trials Working Group 3 (PCWG3) guidelines by BICR, or death, whichever occurs first.. Timeframe: Randomization up to approximately 2 years.. There are 1 registered primary-outcome entries. Protocol publication clarifies final rPFS analysis; operative SAP amendments and event maturity are not independently verified.
evidence.title: MEVPRO-1 frozen registered design

evidence.text: The sponsor-authored protocol publication reports an 81-patient dose-expansion comparison with median rPFS 14.3 months for mevrometostat + enzalutamide versus 6.2 months for enzalutamide. This is not MEVPRO-1 and does not cover its docetaxel comparator. The phase III protocol describes a stratified two-sided log-rank rPFS analysis with no rPFS interim analysis, and hierarchical rPFS then OS testing. Exact current operative SAP, event maturity and adherence remain unknown.

evidence.text:
Frozen registry NCT04895241: TOPAZ-1; enrollment 548 (ACTUAL); allocation RANDOMIZED; masking QUADRUPLE. Selected primary endpoint: Percentage of Participants Who Achieved a Systemic Lupus Erythematosus Responder Index of 4 (SRI-4) Response at Week 52. Definition: SRI-4 response is a composite endpoint defined by the following criteria:

* Reduction from baseline of ≥4 points in systemic lupus erythematosus disease activity index 2000 (SLEDAI-2K).
* No new organ system affected, as defined by no new organ system with British isles lupus assessment group-2004 (BILAG-2004) grade A and no more than 1 new organ system with BILAG-2004 grade B compared with Baseline.
* No worsening from baseline in lupus disease activity as defined by \<0.3-point increase on 3-point Physician's Global Assessment (PGA) - Visual Analog Scale (VAS).
* No violation to protocol-specified medication rules.. Timeframe: Week 52. There are 1 registered primary-outcome entries. High-dose group only. Milligram dose not disclosed in retrieved registry; do not guess. Low-dose success or other TOPAZ-named trial does not resolve target.
evidence.title: TOPAZ-1 frozen registered design

This subgroup does not isolate AVANZAR TROP2-positive patients. Line, combination and comparator differ; this is not an AVANZAR effect estimate.
evidence.title: Indirect later-line randomized Dato evidence

evidence.source_anchor: TROPION-Lung04 first-line efficacy subgroup paragraphs/table; confirmed or pending confirmation
evidence.text: In the small phase Ib TROPION-Lung04 first-line subgroup, Dato-DXd + durvalumab + carboplatin had confirmed-or-pending-confirmation responses in 10/13 patients (76.9%, 95% CI 46.2-95.0). Dato-DXd + durvalumab had 7/14 responses (50%). These are nonrandomized cohorts, response rather than PFS, with no randomized standard-care comparator or isolation of AVANZAR TROP2-positive population. The triplet safety population included 14 patients and must not be given the 13-patient first-line efficacy denominator. This does not establish an AVANZAR effect.
evidence.title: Indirect first-line combination response evidence

evidence.text: WO2020240467A1 Example 7, PDF page 93, Table 2 (data cutoff 2019-11-16): phase 1 open-label DS-1062a in previously treated NSCLC. Investigator-assessed UNCONFIRMED objective responses: 6 mg/kg 5/18 = 27.8% (exact 95% CI 9.7–53.5%); 8 mg/kg 13/34 = 38.2% (22.2–56.4%). 88/95 were response evaluable across ALL dose groups; 88 is not a denominator for either selected dose. No randomized concurrent comparator. This is ORR, not PFS, and cannot be substituted for AVANZAR benefit or compared causally with docetaxel. Patent PDF p87 [0419] identifies ADC(1)=DS-1062a; p88 cites NCT03401385. Official NCI and current registry identify DS-1062a/DS1062a as datopotamab deruxtecan; those identity sources were obtained 2026-10-22. Two AI roles checked pages/identity/numbers, share a base model, and have correlated error risk. Human scientific reviews=0; no clinical validation; full regulatory sequence alignment not performed. Only this selected experiment, not other examples or ADC(2), is included.

evidence.title: AVANZAR frozen registered design

evidence.source_anchor: XML table-wrap id=tbl2, Overall Efficacy for All Patients and by Histology, nonsquamous columns; table footnotes
evidence.text: TROPION-Lung01 was a randomized comparison of Dato-DXd monotherapy versus docetaxel after prior NSCLC therapy. Table 2 reports 234 patients per arm in the nonsquamous histology efficacy subgroup, not 229 versus 232. Median PFS was 5.5 versus 3.6 months, HR 0.63 (95% CI 0.51-0.79). In the overall population, OS was not significantly improved: HR 0.94 (95% CI 0.78-1.14), p=0.530. Histology subgroups used electronic case-report-form data. These patients do not isolate AVANZAR TROP2-positive disease. Treatment line, combination, comparator and hypothesis differ; neither the PFS signal nor the overall OS null result establishes AVANZAR efficacy.
evidence.title: Corrected indirect randomized Dato evidence

evidence.source_anchor: TROPION-Lung04 first-line efficacy subgroup paragraphs/table; confirmed or pending confirmation
evidence.text: In the small phase Ib TROPION-Lung04 first-line subgroup, Dato-DXd + durvalumab + carboplatin had confirmed-or-pending-confirmation responses in 10/13 patients (76.9%, 95% CI 46.2-95.0). Dato-DXd + durvalumab had 7/14 responses (50%). These are nonrandomized cohorts, response rather than PFS, with no randomized standard-care comparator or isolation of AVANZAR TROP2-positive population. The triplet safety population included 14 patients and must not be given the 13-patient first-line efficacy denominator. This does not establish an AVANZAR effect.

evidence.source_anchor: Results from part A and B; About the phase 2 study
evidence.text: Sanofi reported an open-label, multicentre phase 2 CIDP study without a randomized comparator. At week 24, 42/48 SOC-treated patients (87%), 16/18 SOC-refractory patients (89%) and 11/12 SOC-naive patients (92%) improved or remained stable. Improvement alone occurred in 25/48 treated patients (52%) and 9/18 refractory patients (50%). These combined stable-or-improved proportions are not one shared primary response endpoint: Part A primary was relapse after SOC withdrawal for treated patients, and response during treatment for refractory/naive patients. Part B was an optional 52-week extension whose primary endpoint was long-term safety/tolerability. Two deaths occurred in patients with significant comorbidities; the release does not establish drug causality. SOC included immunoglobulins or corticosteroids. Nonrandomization, cohort differences, endpoint differences and selected extension participation prevent an estimate of superiority over maintenance IVIg in VITALIZE.
evidence.title: Indirect open-label riliprubart CIDP week-24 evidence

evidence.source_anchor: Printed PDF page 17: Neurology: riliprubart potential to expand in neuroinflammation; condition immediately above cohort charts
evidence.text: Sanofi's December 2025 presentation reports phase 2 CIDP extension outcomes at week 76 only among patient groups who achieved the week-24 primary endpoint. The conditional cohorts were SOC-treated n=40, SOC-refractory n=9 and SOC-naive n=7: 80% were relapse-free, 78% had sustained response and 86% had sustained response, respectively. Non-evaluable proportions were 13%, 11% and 14%; reported relapse proportions were 7% and 11% in the first two groups. These are open-label conditional extension outcomes, not percentages of the original 48/18/12 cohorts and not randomized treatment effects. They support potential durability in selected responders but cannot estimate VITALIZE week-24 adjusted-INCAT superiority against maintenance IVIg. Part B's primary endpoint was long-term safety/tolerability, as defined in the 2024 study description.

The conditional cohorts were SOC-treated n=40, SOC-refractory n=9 and SOC-naive n=7: 80% were relapse-free, 78% had sustained response and 86% had sustained response, respectively. Non-evaluable proportions were 13%, 11% and 14%; reported relapse proportions were 7% and 11% in the first two groups. These are open-label conditional extension outcomes, not percentages of the original 48/18/12 cohorts and not randomized treatment effects. They support potential durability in selected responders but cannot estimate VITALIZE week-24 adjusted-INCAT superiority against maintenance IVIg. Part B's primary endpoint was long-term safety/tolerability, as defined in the 2024 study description.

evidence.source_anchor: Results from part A and B; About the phase 2 study
evidence.text: Sanofi reported an open-label, multicentre phase 2 CIDP study without a randomized comparator. At week 24, 42/48 SOC-treated patients (87%), 16/18 SOC-refractory patients (89%) and 11/12 SOC-naive patients (92%) improved or remained stable. Improvement alone occurred in 25/48 treated patients (52%) and 9/18 refractory patients (50%). These combined stable-or-improved proportions are not one shared primary response endpoint: Part A primary was relapse after SOC withdrawal for treated patients, and response during treatment for refractory/naive patients. Part B was an optional 52-week extension whose primary endpoint was long-term safety/tolerability. Two deaths occurred in patients with significant comorbidities; the release does not establish drug causality. SOC included immunoglobulins or corticosteroids. Nonrandomization, cohort differences, endpoint differences and selected extension participation prevent an estimate of superiority over maintenance IVIg in VITALIZE.

evidence.source_anchor: XML table-wrap id=tbl2, Overall Efficacy for All Patients and by Histology, nonsquamous columns; table footnotes
evidence.text: TROPION-Lung01 was a randomized comparison of Dato-DXd monotherapy versus docetaxel after prior NSCLC therapy. Table 2 reports 234 patients per arm in the nonsquamous histology efficacy subgroup, not 229 versus 232. Median PFS was 5.5 versus 3.6 months, HR 0.63 (95% CI 0.51-0.79). In the overall population, OS was not significantly improved: HR 0.94 (95% CI 0.78-1.14), p=0.530. Histology subgroups used electronic case-report-form data. These patients do not isolate AVANZAR TROP2-positive disease. Treatment line, combination, comparator and hypothesis differ; neither the PFS signal nor the overall OS null result establishes AVANZAR efficacy.
evidence.title: Corrected indirect randomized Dato evidence

evidence.source_anchor: TROPION-Lung04 first-line efficacy subgroup paragraphs/table; confirmed or pending confirmation
evidence.text: In the small phase Ib TROPION-Lung04 first-line subgroup, Dato-DXd + durvalumab + carboplatin had confirmed-or-pending-confirmation responses in 10/13 patients (76.9%, 95% CI 46.2-95.0). Dato-DXd + durvalumab had 7/14 responses (50%). These are nonrandomized cohorts, response rather than PFS, with no randomized standard-care comparator or isolation of AVANZAR TROP2-positive population. The triplet safety population included 14 patients and must not be given the 13-patient first-line efficacy denominator. This does not establish an AVANZAR effect.
evidence.title: Indirect first-line combination response evidence

evidence.text: WO2020240467A1 Example 7, PDF page 93, Table 2 (data cutoff 2019-11-16): phase 1 open-label DS-1062a in previously treated NSCLC. Investigator-assessed UNCONFIRMED objective responses: 6 mg/kg 5/18 = 27.8% (exact 95% CI 9.7–53.5%); 8 mg/kg 13/34 = 38.2% (22.2–56.4%). 88/95 were response evaluable across ALL dose groups; 88 is not a denominator for either selected dose. No randomized concurrent comparator. This is ORR, not PFS, and cannot be substituted for AVANZAR benefit or compared causally with docetaxel. Patent PDF p87 [0419] identifies ADC(1)=DS-1062a; p88 cites NCT03401385. Official NCI and current registry identify DS-1062a/DS1062a as datopotamab deruxtecan; those identity sources were obtained 2026-10-22. Two AI roles checked pages/identity/numbers, share a base model, and have correlated error risk. Human scientific reviews=0; no clinical validation; full regulatory sequence alignment not performed. Only this selected experiment, not other examples or ADC(2), is included.

evidence.text: TROPION-Lung01 was a randomized comparison of Dato-DXd monotherapy versus docetaxel after prior NSCLC therapy. Table 2 reports 234 patients per arm in the nonsquamous histology efficacy subgroup, not 229 versus 232. Median PFS was 5.5 versus 3.6 months, HR 0.63 (95% CI 0.51-0.79). In the overall population, OS was not significantly improved: HR 0.94 (95% CI 0.78-1.14), p=0.530. Histology subgroups used electronic case-report-form data. These patients do not isolate AVANZAR TROP2-positive disease. Treatment line, combination, comparator and hypothesis differ; neither the PFS signal nor the overall OS null result establishes AVANZAR efficacy.

evidence.text: In the small phase Ib TROPION-Lung04 first-line subgroup, Dato-DXd + durvalumab + carboplatin had confirmed-or-pending-confirmation responses in 10/13 patients (76.9%, 95% CI 46.2-95.0). Dato-DXd + durvalumab had 7/14 responses (50%). These are nonrandomized cohorts, response rather than PFS, with no randomized standard-care comparator or isolation of AVANZAR TROP2-positive population. The triplet safety population included 14 patients and must not be given the 13-patient first-line efficacy denominator. This does not establish an AVANZAR effect.

evidence.text: WO2020240467A1 Example 7, PDF page 93, Table 2 (data cutoff 2019-11-16): phase 1 open-label DS-1062a in previously treated NSCLC. Investigator-assessed UNCONFIRMED objective responses: 6 mg/kg 5/18 = 27.8% (exact 95% CI 9.7–53.5%); 8 mg/kg 13/34 = 38.2% (22.2–56.4%). 88/95 were response evaluable across ALL dose groups; 88 is not a denominator for either selected dose. No randomized concurrent comparator. This is ORR, not PFS, and cannot be substituted for AVANZAR benefit or compared causally with docetaxel. Patent PDF p87 [0419] identifies ADC(1)=DS-1062a; p88 cites NCT03401385. Official NCI and current registry identify DS-1062a/DS1062a as datopotamab deruxtecan; those identity sources were obtained 2026-10-22. Two AI roles checked pages/identity/numbers, share a base model, and have correlated error risk. Human scientific reviews=0; no clinical validation; full regulatory sequence alignment not performed. Only this selected experiment, not other examples or ADC(2), is included.
